query: What mathematical formula is used to calculate Discounted Cumulative Gain (DCG@K) for graded relevance?
ground_truth_answer: Discounted Cumulative Gain is calculated as DCG@K = sum_{i=1}^K (2^{r_i} - 1) / log2(i + 1), where r_i represents the relevance grade of the document at rank position i.
